text:
Maya (CS): Quick weekly ping for SurgeonLabs — tokens + throughput check. QoW tokens: -18%, QoQ +42%. p99 latency spike on api-prod-2, errors ~0.85%. Spend down WoW. Sharing quick dump for context.

Aria (AE): Thanks Maya. Are the new users still in onboarding cohort B? Any recent rollouts that could explain the token delta?

Maya (CS): Yes cohort B ramp was paused last Thu. Frontend team also switched model param to opt-2-small for the A/B pair which dropped token count per response but increased average sequence length on specific flows. Posted a chart in #confluence (link).

Liam (CS): Quick numbers from telemetry: tokens/day 1,220,000 -> 1,000,000 WoW; avg tokens/session 350 -> 420; spend $12.1k -> $9.9k WoW. Latency: p50 110ms, p95 360ms, p99 720ms (was ~320ms last week). Error rate moved 0.2% -> 0.85%.

OpsBot: deploy-bot: Detected +5% CPU on gpu-pool-3 and elevated request queuing on api-prod-2, autoscale triggered.

Nikhil (SRE): I'll investigate KV cache hit rates and batching settings — sounds like a TTL or cache-key change after the param flip. Assigning to myself to check KV metrics and kernel config.

Sophie (CSM): I'll set up an enablement sync with SurgeonLabs to walk through the model change and token expectations. Proposed Thu 10am PT, can anyone join?

Aria (AE): Renewal note: usage down WoW but QoQ growth still healthy. Recommend a short finance review before the enablement call to discuss committed capacity and expected normalization.

Maya (CS): Action items: 1) @Nikhil — investigate cache/latency and report back (EOD tomorrow). 2) @Sophie — schedule enablement Thu 10am PT and include product notes. 3) @Liam — confirm spend delta and prepare a 1-slide usage deck for the call. I'll open a follow thread if we need deeper logs.

Liam (CS): :thumbsup: Will send the deck by EOD.

Sophie (CSM): :calendar: Invite sent to SurgeonLabs CSM + Eng; tentative for Thu 10am PT.

Nikhil (SRE): Update: found TTL mismatch in cache config — miss rate jumped from ~12% -> ~48% after deploy. Rolling back the param on api-prod-2 now and forcing cache warm. Will monitor p99 and error rate.

Maya (CS): Thanks. Keep us posted on p99 trend and error reduction. Marking this as monitored.

OpsBot: incident-tracker: New incident created INC-239876-01 (latency spike on api-prod-2) — assigned to Nikhil.

Aria (AE): Noted, I'll flag this in the renewal review doc and add a short bullet for customer Q/A.

Nikhil (SRE): Rolled back param at 23:12 UTC. Preliminary p99 dropped to ~380ms, error rate trending down to 0.25%. Continuing to monitor.

Maya (CS): :white_check_mark: Great work everyone — follow-ups on deck + enablement. We'll reconvene if metrics regress.
